title: Abba bar Chama
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Avodah Zarah 31a has Rav Chisda saying: “Abba bar Chama told me: Thus Zeira said, the halakhah follows Rabbi Eliezer.” Dikdukei Soferim reads Abba bar Chanan. In 49b Rav Chisda says: “Abba bar Rav Chisda [it should read bar Chanan] told me: Thus Zeiri said, the halakhah follows Rabbi Eliezer.” In 60b he says: “Abba bar Chanan told me: Thus Zeiri said, the halakhah follows Rabbi Shimon.” Dikdukei Soferim reads Abba bar Cham. The Rashba’s Torat HaBayit, 133a, also reads Abba bar Cham, as did Yuchasin, which cites Abba bar Cham with Rav Chisda reporting in his name in chapter Rabbi Yishmael—that is, Avodah Zarah 60b.

notes.text: Both checked passages explicitly name Rabbi Eliezer. Chama, Chanan and Cham, and the Rav Chisda patronymic reading, remain Hyman’s reported variants and proposed corrections.

The consulted Avodah Zarah passages preserve occurrence-specific Abba bar Chama/Chisda and Zeira/Zeiri forms and explicitly name Rabbi Eliezer. The Dikdukei Soferim, Torat HaBayit and Yuchasin readings are reported by Hyman; those exact editions were not independently inspected here.
